description: This file defines a Filter class for parsing and matching test case filters based on various criteria such as project, status, text, labels, and annotations. It includes methods for parsing filter expressions, tokenizing input, and applying filters to test case summaries. Additionally, it provides utility functions for caching search values and updating URL search parameters with filter tokens.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class representing various filter criteria for test cases, with methods to parse expressions, check matches, and determine if empty.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a filter expression string into a Filter object with criteria for project, status, text, labels, and annotations.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if a given test case summary matches the filter criteria.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the filter has no criteria set.
